verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents preset work hours that links can default to, plus per-link custom hours (docs-21, docs-81). It can also restrict a link's offered times to calendar events such as a "Demos" block (docs-12, docs-96). That evidences working-hours schedules but not dedicated date overrides or out-of-office periods. missing for 10: documented date-specific availability overrides, out-of-office/vacation periods, detailed docs on defining named availability schedules, independent corroboration
